t3_source: tekken-wiki TTT2 Jun Kazama movelist (documented, no teardown bank)
frame_convention: Startup in seconds @60fps. Damage = Tekken values, WH 100HP. Hit ranges from the TTT2 movelist; startup values from documented i-frames where known (i10 1,2,4 / i13 b+4,2 / i14 d/f+2,1 / i16 u/f+4,3 / i16 d/b+1,2), otherwise standard Tekken archetype estimates.
canon_note: Megami = the Shrine Soul (roster/parvati). Jun Kazama's Kazama Style Classic Martial Arts kit, rebuilt with Tekken inputs: a guardian's kit — parries, reversals (Attack Reversal), stance transitions (Genjitsu b+1+2, Izumo f+1+2), frame-perfect punishment. Canon-layered: Sealed Door (d/b+1+2), Threshold Keeper (b+1+2~b), Kaimon (GEN 1+2).

canon_wiring.note: Additive canon wiring for the Move List Creator. canon_moves entries are NEW entries; no Tekken moves entry was replaced or overwritten. Existing entries gained only an anim_ref field where one was missing. wh: refs are placeholders for animations not yet authored (see canon file header); made: refs are wiring labels pending the sibling animation lane clips. NOT play-verified.

ttt2_integration.method: Additive wiring only: no existing move entry was modified, reordered, or deleted, and no move that already carried an anim mapping (anim_ref, anim_t3, or t3_row) was touched. Each filled move previously had NO anim mapping of any kind and was matched against the character's decoded TTT2 records by notation_std, with the move name used wherever notation alone was ambiguous (the side and back throws share one notation in TTT2 and are separated by name and approach condition). A move whose notation is only a truncated prefix of a TTT2 sequence, or whose name conflicts with the only record at its notation, was NOT filled and is listed under unmapped. Rule (b) of the lane brief (moves whose only mapping is an explicit stand-in or donor mark) found zero candidates in this file: no move carries a donor_fighter, standin, placeholder, or fallback marker.
ttt2_integration.anim_ref_format: ttt2:jun:row:{n} - the anim_ref carried by the TTT2 record itself
